subject.title: Browser-opened temporary tabs/windows should close automatically after task completion

question: Should primary-agent browser tabs close at ordinary task completion, and what ownership/preservation contract distinguishes temporary automation tabs from user-owned tabs?
rationale: Current behavior intentionally keeps primary-session tabs reusable until idle/cap/reset cleanup, and changing that default can surprise users unless maintainers choose the product contract.

options.title: Adopt ownership-based cleanup
options.body: Track run-owned temporary tabs and close only those at primary-agent terminal completion while preserving explicit user-owned tabs.

options.title: Keep idle/cap cleanup only
options.body: Leave primary tabs reusable and rely on the existing idle and per-session cap cleanup policy.

options.title: Add explicit opt-in behavior
options.body: Expose task-completion cleanup only behind a deliberate setting or command after proving the existing defaults cannot satisfy users.

recommendation.title: Adopt ownership-based cleanup
recommendation.body: Track run-owned temporary tabs and close only those at primary-agent terminal completion while preserving explicit user-owned tabs.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history across the current idle cleanup, reset cleanup, and shared browser lifecycle helper surfaces.
